items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is that rig-smooth is a local property of arrows in WAdm^{Noeth} (source lines 4252-4368, label lemma-rig-smooth-axioms). The solver must first assemble the base-change identification of the completed naive cotangent complexes from two quasi-isomorphisms, then transport an Ext-annihilation bound forward under base change and backward under faithful flatness; the descent direction with its Ext base-change identity is the substantive step. Allowed background: the chapter's completed NL machinery and the cited More on Algebra and Formal Spaces lemmas, delivered as navigation pointers.
